newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET TO INVEST FIM 50 MLN IN REBUILDS.
newsitem.headline: VALMET TO INVEST FIM 50 MLN IN REBUILDS.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said on Friday it would invest over 50 million markka in rebuilding two pilot paper and board machines.
"The investments are timed for 1997 and 1998," Valmet said.
The rebuilds of a pilot tissue machine in Karlstad, Sweden, and a pilot board machine at Inkeroinen, Finland, were part of Valmet's R&D program, it said.
About 30 million markka would be invested at the Karlstad plant and about 20 million at Inkeroinen, Valmet said.
The rebuilds were aimed at "further strengthening the company's position as the technological leader in the field."
